long_biography.plain_text:
Collagen became the product through which Darren Rude built Youtheory into a national consumer-health brand. After a decade as an executive at supplement maker NeoCell, he opened Nutrawise and developed, manufactured and distributed Youtheory’s own formulations rather than relying on a licensing-only model.

Rude treated production as part of the brand’s identity. He kept manufacturing in-house, followed ingredient sourcing from farms to finished bottles and widened the line from collagen to turmeric, probiotics and other supplements. His hands-on mandate covered sales, marketing, product development and distribution, while Youtheory expanded through major retailers and international markets.

Collagen became the product through which Darren Rude built Youtheory into a national consumer-health brand. Rude treated production as part of the brand’s identity. He kept manufacturing in-house, followed ingredient sourcing from farms to finished bottles and widened the line from collagen to turmeric, probiotics and other supplements. His hands-on mandate covered sales, marketing, product development and distribution, while Youtheory expanded through major retailers and international markets.
